verification_note: Read read-only from a physical Snapmaker U1 on a LAN during the beta.23 and v0.7.x acceptance work.
build_volume_source: printable_area 0.5x1 -> 270.5x271 and printable_height 270.05 in data/profiles/snapmaker_u1.json, the known-good U1 machine preset
observed_axis_range_note: Klipper toolhead axis_maximum minus axis_minimum as reported by a real U1. Larger than the printable area because the toolhead travels past the plate to change and purge; it is motion range, not printable volume.
tool_count_source: four Klipper extruder objects (extruder, extruder1, extruder2, extruder3) observed on a real U1
reports_fitted_nozzle_note: live-verified on a real U1: /machine/system_info's product_info.nozzle_diameter is a real, populated per-toolhead array — read by snapstudio_core.moonraker.machine_info(). The earlier profile said the opposite; it was written before this endpoint had ever been queried.
storage_note: traced on a real U1: /machine/system_info reports total_bytes 0 and /server/files/roots reports no sizes, so there is nothing to read

material_state.note: Snapmaker-specific: filament_type / filament_sub_type / filament_color_rgba / filament_exist, one entry per toolhead.

known_unknowns: free storage on the printer — the firmware reports no sizes
how much filament is left on a loaded spool — the printer tracks which spool, not what remains

source_refs.detail: read-only LAN session against a physical Snapmaker U1 on Moonraker port 7125
backend/snapstudio_core/data/profiles/snapmaker_u1.json — the known-good U1 machine preset extracted from a reference project
